violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the back hallway between storerooms, is not tight-fitting between the doors, even though some weatherstripping has been installed. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The dumpster enclosure has has wood pallet, tire, trash, and debris. The dumpster area must be maintained clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
The hand-washing sink in the dishwasher area was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
The hand-washing sink in the dishwasher area was blocked by trash can. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen is lacking proper signage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

Milk was observed held at 44-47 degrees Fahrenheit in the floor refrigerators. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Milk was placed in the freezers to rapidly chill, and refrigerators adjusted colder. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
Current date marking system allows for 8 days. Proper date marking procedures were reviewed by PIC. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The door to the outside, located in the hall between the storage rooms, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
Water observed in the robot coupe and blender bowls. After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils must be air dried. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
Cork boards are not in good repair, one stained with previous water damage, and the other with areas of crumbling cork. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debrisdry storage shelvessmall table in dry storage areaice machineplate warmersknife rackarea beneath food prep sinkplate & tray holder.Portable fans have an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
The dumpster area has an accumulation of vegetation, which can provide harborage for pests.Dumpster area must be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The dumpster lids are broken.Dumpster should be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The grid for the ceiling tiles near the ice machine is in poor repair, unattached and dangling down. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The area outside the doors to the dumpster have an accumulation of cobwebs, dead insects, soil residue and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The window ledge above the ice machine & table has an accumulation of cobwebs, dead insects, and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The electrical switchbox and pipes have an accumulation of dust clumps and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The edge of the ledge between the coffee area and walk ins is in poor repair, with repaired with tape that now lumpy and dirty, not smooth and easily cleanable. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The outside area near the door has an accumulation of wood pallets and vegetation. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
